metadata.title: VSF Onboarding Assistant
metadata.description: Onboarding assistant for new hires: answers from approved documents, with cited sources.

hero.line2: just ask and know the next step
hero.description: The assistant answers from approved documents and points you to the right process and contact. When something has no source, it says so instead of guessing.

intro.heading: One place to ask when you are new here.
intro.text: The assistant brings approved documents, processes and contacts into a single place to ask: sourced, using the version in force, and honest when there is no basis.

chat.label: Sourced answers
chat.sub: You ask, it answers from the documents
chat.titleEnd: in force on the day you ask.
chat.body: Ask about house rules, leave, benefits or security. The assistant only uses approved documents that are in force and answers with verbatim quotes so you can check for yourself. With no basis, it says so.

process.label: Processes and contacts
process.sub: Step by step, right person, right form
process.body: For things you need to do, such as installing software, requesting access or registering a parking card, the assistant lists the steps from the owning team's process. Links, contacts and forms come from the approved catalogue, never invented by the assistant.

ticket.label: Follow-up and tickets
ticket.sub: You confirm before anything is sent
ticket.titleEnd: , and drafts a ticket when action is needed.
ticket.body: When the answer depends on your unit or role, the assistant asks instead of guessing. If another team must act, it drafts a ticket from the form; the ticket is sent only after you confirm.

chat.title: VSF Onboarding Assistant
chat.label: SOURCED Q&A
chat.question: How many days of annual leave do permanent employees get?
chat.answer: Permanent employees get 12 days of annual leave, according to the 2024 annual leave policy.
chat.placeholder: Ask about house rules, leave, devices, accounts...

s1.label: Submit a request with form IT-SW-01 on the IT portal

s2.label: IT forwards it to VinSOC, which scans within 3 working days

s3.label: Only download from the approved software catalogue

s4.label: Never open install links received by chat or email

roles.title: Value for every role
roles.lead: For everyone who shapes the onboarding experience.
roles.flow: From approved documents to answers for newcomers

asker.title: New employee
asker.body: Ask in everyday language, get sourced answers, follow processes step by step and open a ticket when needed.

hr.title: HR
hr.body: Upload documents and approve new versions, review differences between versions, manage processes, links and contacts, and track questions with no document yet.

team.title: Ticket-handling teams
team.body: Receive tickets the user has confirmed, see all details from the form and update the handling status.

admin.title: Administrator
admin.body: Manage accounts, roles and teams, and review the change log of documents and configuration.

cta.heading: Ready to ask?
cta.text: Sign in with the account HR gave you and ask your first question.
